svg.title: Right Brain
svg.desc: The right hemisphere: arcs of circles hung off the same grid's vertices, converging where they meet, signals firing along them, and marks of music, drawing and making — an eighth note, a beamed pair, a pencil, a brush, a cube, a palette, a wave, a pen nib, an ink drop, a spark, a triangle, a star, an open sketchbook and a bulb — thrown out of its contour along six lanes, each flung clear at its own angle and carried off by the wind, shrinking as they go.
